# v4.1.2 Rust tray helper

## Summary

- Fixed pastes being swallowed by the target window's menu bar: releasing Alt quickly after the hotkey makes the window treat it as an Alt tap and activate its menu, so the injected Ctrl+V went to the menu instead of the input. The helper now injects a mask key immediately on hotkey receipt and, if the foreground thread is already in menu mode (`GetGUIThreadInfo` / `GUI_INMENUMODE`), sends Esc to dismiss it before pasting (#2)
- v4.1.1: treat all-zero alpha in 32-bit clipboard DIBs as opaque so saved PNGs are not fully transparent
- v4.1: save-before-paste ordering fix (#4), switchable path style incl. `@` references for Kimi Code CLI / Gemini CLI / Qwen Code (#5), hardened key injection (#2), README FAQ
